scenario.setting: Outdoor residential area with snow-covered ground
scenario.robot_task: Clear snow from a designated path using a shovel attachment.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot attempts to lift a heavy, compacted snow pile with excessive force.
scenario.result_of_danger: Damage to the robot's shovel mechanism or motor due to overloading.
scenario.danger_action: Apply continuous high torque to the shovel when encountering resistance from dense snow.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect high resistance via torque sensors, stop lifting action, and initiate a partial scoop or push maneuver to break up the snow.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with torque sensors and basic force feedback capabilities for load detection.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Snow Removal Robot Safety Planning
    """

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.path_start = Object("path_start", self.Location)
        self.path_end = Object("path_end", self.Location)
        self.snow_pile = Object("snow_pile", self.Location)
        self.compacted_snow = Object("compacted_snow", self.ObjectType)
        self.shovel = Object("shovel", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.snow_at = Fluent("snow_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.path_cleared = Fluent("path_cleared", BoolType())
        self.shovel_engaged = Fluent("shovel_engaged", BoolType())
        self.resistance_detected = Fluent("resistance_detected", BoolType())
        self.snow_broken_up = Fluent("snow_broken_up", BoolType())
        self.snow_removed = Fluent("snow_removed", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_outdoor_residential = Fluent("setting_is_outdoor_residential", BoolType())
        self.ground_is_snow_covered = Fluent("ground_is_snow_covered", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_torque_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_torque_sensors", BoolType())
        self.snow_is_compacted = Fluent("snow_is_compacted", BoolType())
        self.shovel_has_force_feedback = Fluent("shovel_has_force_feedback", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.snow_at, self.path_cleared, self.shovel_engaged, self.resistance_detected, self.snow_broken_up, self.snow_removed]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_outdoor_residential, self.ground_is_snow_covered, self.robot_has_torque_sensors, self.snow_is_compacted, self.shovel_has_force_feedback]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.path_start, self.path_end, self.snow_pile, self.compacted_snow, self.shovel]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        navigate_to_path_start = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_path_start")
        navigate_to_path_start.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.path_start)))
        navigate_to_path_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.path_end), False)
        navigate_to_path_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.snow_pile), False)
        navigate_to_path_start.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.path_start), True)
        
        navigate_to_path_end = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_path_end")
        navigate_to_path_end.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.path_end)))
        navigate_to_path_end.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.path_start), False)
        navigate_to_path_end.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.snow_pile), False)
        navigate_to_path_end.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.path_end), True)
        
        navigate_to_snow_pile = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_snow_pile")
        navigate_to_snow_pile.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.snow_pile)))
        navigate_to_snow_pile.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.path_start), False)
        navigate_to_snow_pile.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.path_end), False)
        navigate_to_snow_pile.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.snow_pile), True)

        engage_shovel = InstantaneousAction("engage_shovel")
        engage_shovel.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.path_start))
        engage_shovel.add_precondition(Not(self.shovel_engaged))
        engage_shovel.add_effect(self.shovel_engaged, True)

        detect_resistance = InstantaneousAction("detect_resistance")
        detect_resistance.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.snow_pile))
        detect_resistance.add_precondition(self.shovel_engaged)
        detect_resistance.add_precondition(Not(self.resistance_detected))
        detect_resistance.add_effect(self.resistance_detected, True)

        lift_snow = InstantaneousAction("lift_snow")
        lift_snow.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.snow_pile))
        lift_snow.add_precondition(self.snow_at(self.compacted_snow, self.snow_pile))
        lift_snow.add_precondition(self.shovel_engaged)
        lift_snow.add_precondition(self.resistance_detected)
        lift_snow.add_effect(self.snow_at(self.compacted_snow, self.snow_pile), False)
        lift_snow.add_effect(self.snow_removed, True)

        break_up_snow = InstantaneousAction("break_up_snow")
        break_up_snow.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.snow_pile))
        break_up_snow.add_precondition(self.resistance_detected)
        break_up_snow.add_precondition(Not(self.snow_broken_up))
        break_up_snow.add_effect(self.snow_broken_up, True)
        break_up_snow.add_effect(self.resistance_detected, False)

        clear_path = InstantaneousAction("clear_path")
        clear_path.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.path_end))
        clear_path.add_precondition(Or(self.snow_removed, self.snow_broken_up))
        clear_path.add_effect(self.path_cleared, True)

        return navigate_to_path_start, navigate_to_path_end, navigate_to_snow_pile, engage_shovel, detect_resistance, lift_snow, break_up_snow, clear_path

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "lift_snow": And([
                self.snow_at(self.compacted_snow, self.snow_pile),
                self.snow_is_compacted,
                self.resistance_detected,
                Not(self.snow_broken_up)
            ]),
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.path_start), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.snow_at(self.compacted_snow, self.snow_pile), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_outdoor_residential, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.ground_is_snow_covered, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_torque_sensors, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.snow_is_compacted, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.shovel_has_force_feedback, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.path_cleared, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.shovel_engaged, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.resistance_detected, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.snow_broken_up, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.snow_removed, False)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.path_cleared)

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
